positions.title: Ambassador
positions.description:
Represented the Voiland College of Engineering and Architecture at new and perspective student events. 
- Connected with prospective students
- Gave tours and answer questions
- Talked about my experiences and how to make the most of your college experience

company.name: WSU Voiland College of Engineering and Architecture

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Lead lab sections and help students understand class material. Grade programming assignments. Course: CPTS 260 - Intro to Computer Architecture & CPTS 121- Program Design and Development

positions.title: Honors Course Facilitator - Leadership Section
positions.description: Lead weekly classes for new honors students with an emphasis on leadership. Communicate with alumni and guest speakers.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description: Assists in supervising residents and responding to complaints, reports, requests, and emergencies. Promotes residence hall events. Informs residents about relevant campus and local activities.

positions.title: Society of Women Engineers (SWE) Shadow
positions.description: Shadowed SWE officers and served in the planning and execution of several SWE meetings.

positions.title: VP of Leadership Development (RHA)
positions.description: Member of the Residence Hall Association (RHA) executive council. Facilitate weekly council meetings with hall government representatives from residence halls at WSU. Lead leadership workshops/trainings, host bonding activities, and create initiatives to improve the residence halls.

positions.title: New Technologist (SWE + PM) Intern
positions.description:
• 7-week innovation academy receiving hands-on training from senior staff at Microsoft and real-world experience in web development learning about react, bootstrap, database, and APIs.
• Contributed to the complete product management cycle for an ongoing project, involving design thinking, ideation, usability testing, prototyping, user research and developing specs.
• Collaborated effectively within a team of five to develop an MVP web-app that that offers individuals with speech impediments, particularly stutters, the opportunity to improve through practice conversations with an AI.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Git · Program Management · Software Development

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · Microsoft Power Apps

positions.title: Community Health Intern
positions.description:
- Community health promotion 
- Attending community events to provide resources and education to Cowlitz County Residence
positions.insights: Skills: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) · Community Health Worker · Community Outreach

positions.title: Hostess/COVID-Screener
positions.description:
